question: Who among the following has written ‘The Bird of Time’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarojini Naidu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Bird of Time** is a poetry collection book by **Indian poet Sarojini Naidu in 1912.**
 
• Sarojini Naidu was an Indian** political activist, feminist, and poet.**
 
• Sarojini Naidu was **elected as the President of the Indian National Congress Party in 1925,** the first-ever Indian woman to assume that position.
 
• A proponent of **civil rights, women's emancipation, and anti-imperialistic ideas,** she was an important person in India's struggle for **independence from colonial rule.**
 
• She was also the first Indian woman to be president of the** Indian National Congress **and to be appointed as governor of an Indian state (United Provinces).
 
• Naidu's literary work as a poet earned her the sobriquet the **“Nightingale of India”, or “Bharat Kokila” **__by Mahatma Gandhi because of the color, imagery, and lyrical quality of her poetry.
 
• Born in a **Bengali family in Hyderabad, Chattopadhyay **was educated in Madras, London, and Cambridge.
